snippet.title: Metabolis - Complete (C64) - 4K
snippet.description:
Found on the flip side of the original release of Bounder, I vividly recall playing this rather quirky title round a friend's house during my teenage years, and us completing it as well. In retrospect, it isn't half as hard as I remember, with the only real hazard in the game being those damn ninja stars that randomly appear on certain screens, which can and will kill you instantly if you stupidly blunder into the bloody annoying things. (^o^)

No need for me to bother with the story either because the scrolling message at the bottom of the screen in the first few minutes of the video explains exactly what has happened to you and what you need to do to reverse the situation. Suffice it to say, it's pretty much a memory game, with you having to work out which rooms need to be visited and in what order to collect the various items necessary to win. (^_~)

One other thing worth mentioning perhaps is I had an erroneous memory of the man turning into a Superman lookalike, complete with cape and the customary 'S', after you touch the wizard and cure your ills. Not sure where that came from, possibly another game I played around the same time, or maybe even one of the 80s movies, who knows!? (^_^;)

Chris & I did actually do a commentary for this one also, except me being me, I neglected to add the link to it, despite it being well over a year ago now:-

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Awxzn2LuYSE
